name: Nothing Happened
source:
A young genius and his female AR companion are given a mission at the Ateneo de Manila University: to be productive.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2015/games/nothing-happened]Global Game Jam[/url]]

一位年轻的天才和他的AR女伙伴在马尼拉雅典耀大学被赋予了一项使命：提高生产力。
